T-RP-11.rules: Serialize all backup/cleanup by OS process lease flock; crash releases lock, never steals living lock. Unique caller runId bound to DB/kind/sources; same completed id verified/idempotent, different binding conflict; in-progress orphan preserved. Dump custom format validates pg_restore listing/hash. Actual directory file snapshot rsync --link-dest only fully hash verified previous published pair; no in-place/chmod published links; validate file bytes/metadata/symlinks and same-FS stage rename. Both paths complete before atomic pair.json published/latest pointer; interrupted partial unpublished, oldlatest unchanged. Retention only validates published pair and removes both underlease, minlast two/latest/pins/last verified protected, unknown legacy/orphans preserved; no automatic orphan deletion. Defaults daily30weekly84monthly365predeployneverexpire, target budget/retentionactual external. Explicit no claim common write-point yet; RP19 barrier refinement.
